diagnosis: Customer disputes invoice INV-88410 for 30 removed seats expecting ~$1,200 credit. Per kb-0011, seat removals take effect at next renewal and are not credited mid-cycle, which likely explains the invoice still showing old seat count. This is an enterprise/premium account with custom SLA requiring careful handling of the disputed amount.
reply:
Thank you for contacting us about invoice INV-88410. I understand you removed 30 seats on the 3rd and expected to see a reduction in your invoice.

I've reviewed the details provided. According to our billing policy, seat removals take effect at your next renewal and are not credited mid-cycle, which means the current invoice would still reflect your previous seat count.

I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
